strapiBlog.title: Where to Find Serviced Apartments in Dubai?
strapiBlog.short_description: Dubai's dynamic lifestyle and booming tourism industry make it a prime destination for short-term rentals, commonly known as serviced apartments in Dubai.

data.text:
Dubai's dynamic lifestyle and booming tourism industry make it a prime destination for short-term rentals, commonly known as serviced apartments in Dubai. These fully furnished rentals offer flexibility and convenience for leisure and business travelers, blending the comfort of a home with hotel-like amenities.

From waterfront views to bustling city centers, serviced apartments in Dubai are designed to suit various tastes and needs.

In this article, we highlight the top five best areas to rent serviced apartments in Dubai, giving you insight into the city’s most sought-after neighborhoods and the exceptional rentals they provide.

Top 5 Areas with Serviced Apartments in Dubai

Downtown Dubai

Known as the heart of Dubai, Downtown Dubai is a bustling hub of luxury, entertainment, and iconic landmarks, including the Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall. With world-class shopping, dining, and cultural experiences, this area is ideal for those wanting to be at the center of it all.

Address Downtown

Located in the heart of Dubai, Address Downtown offers luxury apartments in Dubai with panoramic views of the Burj Khalifa and Dubai Fountain. These rentals combine elegance and modernity, featuring full kitchens, spacious layouts, and access to world-class facilities.

  • Price: From AED 3,299 per night

DAMAC Maison Distinction

This high-rise in Downtown Dubai boasts sleek serviced apartments for rent in Downtown Dubai, ideal for long and short stays. Guests enjoy easy access to Dubai Mall, while also having the convenience of in-apartment laundry, housekeeping, and 24-hour concierge services.

  • Price: From AED 1,174 per night

Dubai Marina

Dubai Marina is a vibrant, waterfront neighborhood that offers a stunning skyline and a cosmopolitan lifestyle. It’s home to yacht-lined marinas, trendy restaurants, and a lively nightlife scene, making it a top choice for travelers looking to experience serviced apartments near Dubai Marina with coastal views.

InterContinental Dubai Marina Residences

Offering stunning waterfront views, the InterContinental Dubai Marina Residences provides luxury serviced apartments in Dubai with full amenities. Ideal for those seeking a vibrant city vibe, it’s close to dining, shopping, and nightlife options.

  • Price: From AED 1,241 per night

Marina View Hotel Apartments

A favorite among travelers, Marina View offers affordable yet stylish short-term serviced apartments in Dubai. Each unit is designed with a home-like ambiance, featuring kitchen facilities, spacious living areas, and access to a pool and fitness center.

  • Price: From AED 509 per night

Palm Jumeirah

The Palm Jumeirah is an iconic, man-made archipelago known for its luxury hotels, private beaches, and upscale residences. It’s a prestigious destination that offers exclusive access to beachfront, family-friendly serviced apartments in Dubai, catering to those seeking a lavish and relaxed stay.

FIVE Palm Jumeirah Residences

Known for its iconic architecture and luxury lifestyle, FIVE Palm Jumeirah provides pet-friendly serviced apartments in Dubai that redefine beachfront living. With breathtaking ocean views, these apartments offer full access to hotel amenities, including pools, restaurants, and beach clubs.

  • Price: From AED 1,825 per night

Fairmont The Palm Residences

Fairmont offers an array of serviced apartments for families in Dubai designed for ultimate relaxation. These elegant apartments come with private balconies, full kitchens, proximity to private beach access, and a range of fine dining options.

  • Price: From AED 1,531 per night

Business Bay

Business Bay is a vibrant business district strategically located near Downtown Dubai. It’s a hub for professionals and corporate travelers, offering a blend of serviced apartments in Dubai for business and leisure, modern infrastructure, and easy access to major city landmarks.

SLS Dubai Hotel & Residences

Situated in Business Bay, SLS Dubai offers trendy and modern Business Bay serviced apartments for executives perfect for business and leisure. The apartments feature stylish interiors, access to rooftop pools, a spa, and upscale dining, creating a balanced work-life experience.

  • Price: From AED 1,330 per night

Millennium Atria Business Bay

Millennium Atria’s serviced apartments in Dubai provide a contemporary, homely environment for short-term stays. Each apartment is fully equipped, and residents benefit from easy access to the city’s business districts and iconic landmarks.

  • Price: From AED 671

Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR)

Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR) is a lively beachfront area known for its pedestrian-friendly promenade, The Walk, lined with cafes, boutiques, and entertainment options. It’s perfect for families and groups wanting easy beach access and affordable serviced apartments in JBR Dubai.

JA Oasis Beach Tower

Overlooking the Arabian Gulf, JA Oasis Beach Tower offers spacious serviced apartments in Dubai with full kitchens and luxury facilities. It’s an ideal option for families and groups, with easy access to the beach, The Walk, and multiple entertainment options.

  • Price: From AED 1,776

Roda Amwaj Suites

Roda Amwaj Suites is a popular choice in JBR, featuring spacious family-friendly serviced apartments in Dubai with kitchens, laundry facilities, and breathtaking views of the Marina and Gulf. With its family-friendly environment and beach access, it’s a favorite among travelers.

  • Price: From AED 1,063

These top neighborhoods for serviced apartments in Dubai offer prime locations, luxury, and convenience, making Dubai an exceptional choice for short-term rental stays. Popular areas with serviced apartments in Dubai cater to diverse preferences and provide world-class experiences in the city’s most prestigious locations.

faqs.question: Are serviced apartments in Dubai suitable for families?

data.answer: Yes, many family-friendly serviced apartments in Dubai offer spacious layouts with multiple bedrooms, full kitchens, and family-friendly amenities. Areas like Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, and JBR are trendy among families looking for a comfortable and convenient stay.

faqs.question: Do serviced apartments in Dubai offer flexible rental terms?

data.answer: Most serviced apartments in Dubai provide flexible rental terms, allowing guests to book short-term or long-term stays. This flexibility makes them ideal for both vacationers and business travelers who may need extended accommodations.

faqs.question: Are utilities and Wi-Fi included in the cost of a serviced apartment in Dubai?

data.answer: Typically, utilities like electricity, water, and Wi-Fi are included in the rental price of serviced apartments in Dubai. However, it’s always best to confirm these details with the apartment provider before booking.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I book a serviced apartment in Dubai?

data.answer: Booking a few weeks in advance is recommended, especially during peak tourist seasons. Areas like Downtown Dubai and Palm Jumeirah can be in high demand, so early reservations ensure better availability and possibly lower rates.

faqs.question: Do serviced apartments in Dubai provide airport transfer services?

data.answer: Some serviced apartments in Dubai offer airport transfer services, either complimentary or at an additional fee. It’s best to inquire directly with the apartment management to arrange transfers and ensure a smooth arrival in Dubai.
